preconditions.expression: len(s) <= 200 and all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: s is a bracket sequence of no more than 200 characters.

preconditions.expression: len(t) <= 200 and all(c in '()' for c in t)
preconditions.description: t is a bracket sequence of no more than 200 characters.

postconditions.description: The output is a regular bracket sequence.
s is a subsequence of the output.
t is a subsequence of the output.
The output has the minimum possible length among all regular bracket sequences containing both s and t as subsequences.
